free_text: A biopsy is recommended because the biochemical evidence strongly suggests progression despite a low imaging score. The patient has a rising PSA velocity of 0.78 ng/mL/yr and a prior positive biopsy, which are significant factors. Although the PI-RADS score is 2, the rising PSA from 6.7 ng/mL to 8.3 ng/mL, coupled with the prior positive result, warrants further investigation to rule out clinically significant disease.
